title: The fourteen regions and the country
note: Subjects for the latent runs, which ask about a place rather than a person: fifteen areas, numbered 1..15 in the order of regions.csv. The country is a subject like the regions; which row of a reference table is the whole is the topic's business (its reference.total). regions.csv also carries an approximate population per area (the former notebook's numbers; the ranking is right, the figures are not exact), which analysis uses only to order groups in figures; it is not a values column.
